method.life_key: actual entity ID and native spawned_tick; observations ordered by native tick and source line
method.groups: all groups merged by actual slot/ID; duplicate samples retained only as observations, never extra lives
method.acquisition: first observed alive owned-mask with useful bit; sampled upper bound, not exact pickup instant
method.death: first same-life nonpositive health; otherwise next native spawn marks inferred life end
method.selection: separate first current-useful weapon with has_ammo; inventory ownership is not a firing or hit claim
method.initial_position: sha256 of compact JSON three floats; complete raw vectors remain private

receipt.observer_input_schedule: one normal mouse pulse before observation; no periodic input during bounded action diagnostic

first_state_limit: Initial samples occur0.60–0.65s after common spawn0.95; neither exact first-state nor equal initial placements claimed.
time_basis: Client ticks identify actions only. Acquisition uses native game_tick-spawned_tick. Hook elapsed uses entered_ms-gameplay_window_start_ms. Inventory elapsed is loop-start time and can precede individual samples.

coverage.meaning: observed listener lifetime overlap; not complete gameplay/event proof
